text: Now, being inherently free and all-pervading, how does he wander? [It is said that] wandering is for the purpose of attaining that which has not been attained. By this [notion], the Purusha is described as being bound, liberated, or wandering. However, through the knowledge of the distinction between Sattva and Purusha, the state of wandering does not exist, and the true nature of the Purusha is revealed.
